restart_prompt.title: Restart XPC tunnel
restart_prompt.body:
DDI mounted successfully.

On iOS 17+, an XPC tunnel established before this mount does not include the developer services that only appear after mounting (such as testmanagerd), which prevents Key/Mouse / WDA from starting.

The XPC tunnel must be restarted to enable these services (administrator authorization will be requested). Restart now?
restart_prompt.declined: Mounted; XPC tunnel not restarted — Key/Mouse / WDA may be unavailable. You can retry from the “Restart” button in the tunnel panel above.

ready.timeout: DVT readiness timed out: click “Refresh” to retry or re-mount

unmount.info_body:
DDI unmounted successfully.

Note: on iOS 17+, if Xcode is installed on macOS, its CoreDevice background services may auto re-mount the developer image within seconds, so a later “Refresh” may show it mounted again — this is system behavior, not an unmount failure.
